scope: Durable combined network report preparation before ciphertext upload
behavior: After sealing, save the ciphertext envelope, decryption key, salt and report identifier through an exclusive encrypted autosave lease before invoking ciphertext PUT.
The copy retains pendingReport.submissionStarted=false; transaction intent and identifier checkpoints remain separate later stages.
The preparation save has a one-minute continuation deadline. Errors stop the writer and prevent upload. Already-started storage may still commit.
Generation checks reject preparation/upload continuations after App unmount, including a successful delayed PUT response before SDK setup.
Upload retries reuse the retained sealed report and save its preparation again; no recovery format changes. Guided-local mode does not acquire a mandatory writer.

coverage: Deferred preparation save gates upload; storage error, timer expiry, undispatched-timer wall expiry and closed session do not release it.
Real application encryption with mocked storage/wallet: preparation quota failure prevents PUT and SDK work.
At a paused PUT, decrypting the captured browser-copy write recovers the exact uploaded envelope plus key/salt and an unstarted submission marker.
Unmount during PUT followed by a successful response does not invoke private-state setup, submitReport or broadcast.
Existing application network lifecycle, deployment, restoration, uncertain transaction and final-save failure regression.

developmentFailure.reason: An existing wallet-failure assertion used the default one-second wait, which no longer covered the extra encrypted save. The specific wait now allows five seconds; the complete related group subsequently passed.

limits: No fresh full regression, browser E2E, container refresh, native wallet signing, or physical crash/power-loss validation.
A preparation copy reflects one point in time and can become stale if a later submission starts. An old unstarted marker does not establish global retry safety.
Authenticated transaction reconciliation and automatic promotion of an already-submitted pending report remain open.
